name: What is the typical process for an exterior finish carpentry project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for an exterior finish carpentry project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process starts with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, inspect the existing structure, and understand your needs. We then provide a detailed proposal outlining materials, scope, and timeline. Once approved, our skilled carpenters prepare the site, execute the work with precision, and conduct a final walkthrough to ensure your satisfaction. Communication is key, and we keep you informed at each stage, especially regarding weather impacts in areas like Boise.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes consultation, proposal, site preparation, carpentry work, and a final walkthrough to ensure satisfaction.
